entities.name: Archon
entities.description: A creature type for mystical celestial beings aligned with white, with obscured faces, always on a flying steed.

entities.name: Agnomakhos
entities.description: The most notable Theran archon tyrant, who used the leonin as an army.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: Ravnican archon who formed a detective agency after the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God who took pity on an archon and gave it a spear.

entities.name: Kenrith twins
entities.description: Twins an archon watched and protected from redcaps during the Wildered Quest.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Ravnican guild closely aligned with archons.

entities.name: Age of Trax
entities.description: The era of Theran archon tyranny, from their march from the north to the fall of their empires.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane where archons once held a massive empire.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: Plane where archons guard the border of the Wilds.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where archons align with the Azorius.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: Where despondent archons took refuge and were twisted.

events.summary: In ancient times the archons of Theros hold a massive empire in the Age of Trax, tyrannizing the world in the belief they imposed strict justice, until their empires fall.
events.quote: the archons of Theros held a massive empire, tyrannizing the world in the belief that they were imposing strict justice.

events.summary: Heliod takes pity on an archon and gives it a spear in exchange for the rule of law in the wildest places.
events.quote: Heliod took pity on the archon and gave it a spear almost as radiant as his own

events.summary: Some despondent archons take refuge in the Underworld and are twisted into monstrous variants.
events.quote: Some of the despondent archons took refuge in the Underworld

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion the archon Ezrim forms a detective agency.
events.quote: the archon Ezrim formed a detective agency

events.summary: During the Wildered Quest an Eldraine archon watches and protects the Kenrith twins from redcaps.
events.quote: an archon watched the Kenrith twins from the trees and protected them from redcaps

relations.quote: Archons seem to be closely aligned to the Azorius Senate

relations.note: Most notable archon tyrant of Theros.
relations.quote: The most notable of these Archon tyrants was Agnomakhos
